tagline: Global leader in beverage alcohol, building iconic brands across spirits, beer, and wine
hero_kpi_rationale: The 28.1% operating margin reflects Diageo's financial discipline and efficient operational management in an inflationary environment. This metric is structural and comparable, demonstrating the company's ability to convert revenue into operating profit.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The share of revenue that remains after paying production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 59.6%, showing slight improvement compared to the prior year, driven by effective price and cost management.
kpis.signal: Gross margin stability despite cost inflation

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: The percentage of revenue that becomes profit before taxes.
kpis.description: Operating margin remains stable at 28.1%, reflecting discipline in operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Operating margin maintained despite growing investments

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: What the company spends on research and development relative to its revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending represents 1.2% of revenue, showing slight increase, primarily focused on product innovation and packaging.
kpis.signal: Modest R&D, consistent with a brand-driven model rather than technology-driven

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Money invested in factories, machinery, or buildings.
kpis.description: CAPEX amounts to $900 million, up 12%, supported by energy efficiency and capacity projects.
kpis.signal: CAPEX growth to modernize production facilities

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount is 27,500 employees, down 2%, linked to efficiency gains and digital transformation.
kpis.signal: Headcount reduction in an optimization context

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the 7 most recent fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 14.8064 GBp in the last fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the 4 most recent fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 2.298 billion GBp in the last fiscal year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the 4 most recent fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 97.6% in the last fiscal year.

risks.title: Risk of fraud and manipulation of financial statements
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned mid-report in the audit section; language used is moderate ('principal risks were related to posting inappropriate journal entries'); stable risk identified annually by auditors; the regulatory/fraud category carries strong weight in the assessment.

risks.title: Non-compliance with anti-corruption and tax laws
risks.score_rationale: Positioned mid-report in the audit responsibilities section; language is factual but serious ('non-compliance might have a material effect on the financial statements'); stable recurring risk; the regulatory category carries strong weighting.

risks.title: Revenue decline over two consecutive fiscal years
risks.score_rationale: Visible directly in the consolidated income statement at the end of the financial section; language is factual (figures: $29,751M in 2022, $28,270M in 2023, $27,891M in 2024); risk trend increasing as sales decline accelerates; competition category carries moderate weighting.

risks.title: Rising financial charges weighing on profitability
risks.score_rationale: Data presented in the consolidated income statement in the financial section; finance charges rose from $1,217M to $1,285M over two years, upward trend; language is factual but the impact on profit before tax is direct and measurable; capital category carries moderate weighting.

risks.title: Decline in net profit attributable to shareholders
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in the consolidated income statement in the financial section; profit attributable to shareholders fell from $4,280M to $3,870M over two years, a decline of 9.6%; rising risk trend; capital category carries moderate weighting.

risks.title: Risk of exceeding the audit tenure limit for the same firm
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the end of the audit report; language is neutral and informative ('period of total uninterrupted engagement is 9 years'); stable risk as the situation is known and subject to regulatory oversight; regulatory category carries strong weighting but impact is limited here.

ai_positioning.summary: Diageo mentions no significant strategy or initiatives regarding artificial intelligence in its financial documents. The company focuses on brands, distribution, and consumer experience.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the 2024 annual report
No references to AI tools in supply chain management or marketing
Absence of KPIs related to AI adoption or technology innovation
